## The application task

Describe what a person or coding agent is trying to accomplish and where Canon falls short. Include a concrete screen, workflow or minimal example of the current limitation.

## Proposed result

Explain what should become possible and how someone would use it. For a component or pattern, describe its anatomy, meaningful states and responsive behavior. For an integration, include the tool and workflow it should support.

## Existing options

Which Canon components, patterns or commands did you try? Explain why composing them does not meet the need and any workaround you use today.

## How to verify it

List observable acceptance criteria, including relevant keyboard or accessibility behavior. Include sketches or examples if they clarify the request, using fictional data.

## Contribution interest

Optionally describe whether you can help with implementation, examples, tests or review.
